title: Agent Deck progress card (protocol v2)
description: Live progress of one task, written by the worker through 'deck card …' (or POST /api/tasks/{id}/card). The daemon MERGES patches into the stored card and appends every accepted patch to card_history; a card is never replaced or reset. Unknown keys are rejected with a clear error (exit 2), never silently ignored.

attempt.description: Attempt that last wrote the card.

id.description: Stable key; derived from the title on 'step add' if omitted.

etaMin.description: Estimated minutes for this step. Required.

startedAt.description: Set by the daemon when status becomes active.

attempt.description: Attempt that added the step (continuations append, older steps keep their attempt number).

kind.description: bad = errors (red when > 0); pass = tests passing.

question.description: Open question raised with 'deck ask' (task is 'blocked' until answered).

warnings.description: Normalisations applied to legacy (v1) cards, shown on the UI, e.g. "step key 'name' renamed to 'title'".
